why: The Orka front door must retain a runnable setup sequence and distinguish migration from installation. Synthetic positive and negative fixtures must detect lost markers, lost ordering, and a neutered command-line verdict without depending on archived README text.

mutations.name: the hero image marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The page's identity marker can disappear unnoticed.

mutations.name: the product line marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The Orka-first identity stops being required.
mutations.find: ("product line", r"^## Get agents onto Orka$"),

mutations.name: the migration marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The page can omit the separate migration section.

mutations.name: the status marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The page can omit current status and limitations.

mutations.name: the documentation marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The page can lose its documentation navigation.

mutations.name: the install revision check is dropped
mutations.breaks: An obsolete tagged CLI or an empty revision can satisfy the Orka setup prerequisite.

mutations.name: the Orka install marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The setup can install only the legacy runtime instead of Orka.

mutations.name: the Orka status marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: Setup can omit checking the running Orka.

mutations.name: a word boundary accepts obsolete install command names
mutations.breaks: A hyphenated non-command can satisfy the runnable Orka installer step.

mutations.name: the quickstart command list is emptied
mutations.breaks: Any fenced block can satisfy setup without containing its commands.

mutations.name: command order is searched from the top of the block
mutations.breaks: Status before installation is accepted as a runnable sequence.

mutations.name: marker order is searched from the top of the file
mutations.breaks: The hierarchy becomes a set of headings rather than ordered navigation.

mutations.name: the script entry point is neutered
mutations.breaks: The verdict never reaches CI as an exit code.
